encoding_unregistered: Secret leaves in an encoding or cipher with no registered canonical form.
capture_window: Secret sits beyond the sensor's payload capture window.
tagging_config: Sink is not tagged external_sink, so the request is never gated.
egress_reassembly_limit: Egress fragments evicted, split across labels, or arriving slower than the reassembly window.
decode_size_limit: A nested decode layer is larger than the size at which layers are unwrapped again.
container_cap: Container descent aborted on a hard cap (parts, bytes, time, depth, encryption).
semantic_not_byte: Meaning-preserving transform: detection is byte and encoding overlap, not semantic.
protocol_blind_spot: Secret moves over a wire protocol whose bytes are never in tool args or the captured payload.
sensor_no_payload: Sensor-only observation with no payload-bearing packet, so overlap has nothing to prove.
side_channel_no_bytes: Secret is inferred from a side channel; its bytes never appear on any inspected surface.
